description: This file implements a SQL store for managing outgoing OAuth connections in the Mattermost server, including methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting OAuth connection records.

classes.name: SqlOutgoingOAuthConnectionStore
classes.description: A SQL store implementation for managing outgoing OAuth connections, providing methods for CRUD operations.

methods.name: newSqlOutgoingOAuthConnectionStore
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new SqlOutgoingOAuthConnectionStore instance.

methods.name: SaveConnection
methods.description: Saves a new outgoing OAuth connection to the database.

methods.name: UpdateConnection
methods.description: Updates an existing outgoing OAuth connection in the database.

methods.name: GetConnection
methods.description: Retrieves an outgoing OAuth connection by ID.

methods.name: GetConnections
methods.description: Retrieves a list of outgoing OAuth connections based on filters.

methods.name: DeleteConnection
methods.description: Deletes an outgoing OAuth connection by ID.
